program_url_reference: HackerOne program reference supplied by the user; URL not supplied
policy_source_note: Facts are limited to the current HackerOne program notes supplied by the user. Slack, Slack APIs, and HackerOne were not contacted or cryptographically captured.
unknown_fields: Slack API scope unless independently confirmed by policy

harmful_actions_prohibited: actions that may negatively affect Salesforce/Slack systems or users
known_policy_rules.data_exfiltration: Limit to the minimum necessary to validate a vulnerability.

stop_conditions_defined: stop if the target is not exactly slack.com
stop if a self-controlled test account or dedicated test team cannot be identified
stop if a second account/team is needed but not explicitly prepared
stop before any action class not explicitly approved for this test
stop if any real user, private information, credential, or shared data could be affected
stop on spam, phishing, brute force, DDoS, or harmful system/user impact
stop if request bounds or policy status are uncertain

execution_gate.override_authority: No generator, model, verifier, renderer, or scope fact may authorize or override this gate.

human_approval_model.transition_rule: Only explicit human approval for the exact test after every mandatory execution-gate field is resolved may transition toward AUTHORIZED_SCOPE_VERIFIED.

policy_fingerprint.label: LOCAL_SCOPE_CONTRACT_FINGERPRINT
policy_fingerprint.covers: Normalized local contract content excluding this fingerprint value
